messages:
Maria P: Quick sync — we need to lock GA gating for Dedicated reserved pools + burst. Draft list of must-haves below, please react with :thumbsup: if OK or suggest additions.
Maria P: 1) SLA: 99.95% reserved-pool availability + p95 latency target for small (<=512 tokens) requests.
Maria P: 2) Billing: burst credits must export to billing CSV and integrate with invoice exports (customer ask).
Maria P: 3) Migration: tooling to migrate existing customers from soft-lease to reserved pools without downtime (self-service + SRE-assisted paths).
Maria P: 4) Autoscale: soft headroom + predictive ramping; hard evict only after configurable grace window.
Maria P: 5) Fairness: tenant spillover and throttles documented; default fairshare policy and opt-out for enterprise.
Maria P: 6) Observability: per-tenant per-pool latency/cost dashboards, alerting on burst exhaustion.
Maria P: 7) Rollout: canary with 2 customers, then staged GA; clear fallback to hosted models.
Devon K: +1 on billing export. Need to confirm CSV schema — finance needs cost_center + committed_units + burst_used.
Sanjay R: SLA numbers look tight but achievable. Need infra runbook for pool failover and preemption testing.
Elaine W: Migration tooling: recommend a UI flow + CLI. Also add 'quota reconciliation run' as part of migration.
Devon K: Also flag: pricing impact. Product should propose pricing delta for reserved vs burst usage.
Sanjay R: Autoscale detail: predictive ramping needs model of tenant traffic patterns; start with rule-based heuristics.
Maria P: Action items: Devon -> CSV schema by Thu; Sanjay -> runbook doc + test plan; Elaine -> migration UX mockups. I'll draft gating RFC by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/ga-gating-rfc pushed to staging at 1712350100.
Elaine W: I'll sync with sales on canary customers, they have two interested accounts.
Devon K: one more — include 'burst credit visibility' in console (customers asked to see remaining credits).
Maria P: Good. If no objections, we'll mark this as basis for the RFC and circle back in product sync Monday.
